hook: Plant a coaster's footings in the ground, choose how each one meets it, and the track you get is the polynomial, drawn to scale. Then survey hidden tracks with synthetic division.
outcome: Connect the zeros, multiplicities and leading coefficient of a polynomial to its graph, and use the remainder theorem to find factors
sources: OpenStax, College Algebra 2e, 5.3 Graphs of Polynomial Functions (CC BY 4.0): https://openstax.org/books/college-algebra-2e/pages/5-3-graphs-of-polynomial-functions
OpenStax, College Algebra 2e, 5.4 Dividing Polynomials and 5.5 Zeros of Polynomial Functions (CC BY 4.0): https://openstax.org/books/college-algebra-2e/pages/5-5-zeros-of-polynomial-functions
Common Core State Standards for Mathematics, High School Algebra (A-APR) and Functions (F-IF): https://www.thecorestandards.org/Math/Content/HSA/APR/
Plans, orders and blueprints are original, checked by expansion and numeric sampling (2026-10-25)
Track, plane, car and fog drawn in code; sounds generated in the browser
Background images generated on this PC with FLUX.1-schnell (Apache 2.0), no people
Narration generated with Qwen3-TTS (Apache 2.0), cloning a Google Gemini text-to-speech voice
